report.method: 48 source hues, each assigned one of six cyclic traversals of the same 21 W/B cells. Rank 0 is the vivid tip; H=(source H + rank*7.5/21) modulo 360. The next source hue is excluded. Preserve all sixteen v1 grays.
report.interpretation: Translate the freehand curves to three adjacent-cell walks: inward spiral, alternating columns, and outer edge followed by folded columns. Pair each with exact W/B reflection, keeping the vivid tip fixed. Do not reverse hue direction for mirrors.
report.conversion: OKHSV V=1-B; S=1-W/(1-B). B=1 is explicitly black. Use Ottosson reference conversion, clamp small numerical boundary excursions, round nearest sRGB byte half up.
report.diagram: Source-hue panels contain shifted hues. Cells retain the same W/B geometry as v1. Optional numbered lines connect cell interiors in traversal order; they do not add colors or indicate perceptual distance.
report.grayscale_axis: Even steps in W along W+B=1, equivalent to even OKHSV V steps.
